# Level Up Info

**When you level up, a small window in Blizzard's own trainer style shows what you gained and which class skills you can now buy, with their price.**

![The Level Up Info window congratulating you on reaching level 12: health, mana and stamina gains under Stats, a new skill with its price, and new ranks with what changed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/LevelUpInfo/master/.github/assets/window-preview-congrats.png)

![The Level Up Info window at level 14: health, mana and stamina gains, new skills with prices, and missed ranks with what changed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/LevelUpInfo/master/.github/assets/window-preview.png)
![The Level Up Info window at level 5 with the Classic look: gains, skills not yet learned, and weapon skills with their weapon master and city](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/LevelUpInfo/master/.github/assets/window-preview-classic.png)

## Why players install it

- **See your gains at a glance.** Health, mana, talent points and stats you got from the new level.
- **Know what to train.** New class skills for your level, with icon, rank and price.
- **Blizzard look, no libraries.** Zero cost when idle, tiny cost when it works.

## What you see

A small window in Blizzard's own trainer style opens when you level up:

- **Gains.** One line per stat that changed, each stat name in its own color, shown as old value, a green up arrow, then the new value (for example `Stamina 25 ▲ 26`). Talent points show as `▲ +1 Talent points`.
- **Skills.** New class skills for your level under **New skills**, new ranks of skills you already have under **New ranks**. Each row shows the icon, name, rank and price. The price turns red when you cannot afford it. Hover a row for the spell tooltip. Each group's heading shows the total price of the group when it lists two or more priced skills.
- **What changed.** A new rank lists what changed from the rank before it, like patch notes: for example `Healing: 47-58 → 76-91` or `Mana cost: 30 → 45`. Missed ranks under **Not yet learned** show it too.
- **Long lists.** **Not yet learned** and **Weapon skills** show their first 4 rows; click `+N more` to scroll through the rest right in the window, and `Show less` to shrink it back. Click the **Not yet learned**, **Weapon skills** or **Hidden** heading to fold the whole group, and it stays folded on your next level-up.
- **Hide skills you don't want.** Hover a skill row and click the crossed eye to hide it, all its ranks, for that character. Hidden skills wait in a folded **Hidden** group at the bottom, with their total price; a faint eye always shows there, click it to bring one back, or press **Show hidden skills** in the options to bring them all back.
- **Learning from trainers.** The addon learns skills and prices from class trainers you visit. Until your race has visited its trainer for the new level, the window adds a line telling you to visit your class trainer. Priests come with the class trainer's list built in, so the line asking for a trainer visit shows for other classes only.
- **Next level.** The window ends with a folded **Next at N** group, for example `Next at 14 (2)` with its total price. Click it to see what the trainer will teach you at the next level that has something new, with prices, like the other groups. It folds again each time the window opens. The skills come from the class trainers you have visited (for priests, also from the built-in list).

The window closes by itself after a few seconds. Hover it to keep it open, drag it to move it, or press the X to close it. If you level up in combat, it waits until combat ends.

## Settings

Open them with `/lui` or under Options, AddOns, Level Up Info.

| Setting | What it does | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled | Show the window on level-up | On |
| Duration | Seconds before the window closes (3 to 30) | 10 |
| Wait for combat to end | Hold the window until you leave combat | On |
| Scale | Window size (0.5 to 1.5) | 1.0 |
| Reduced motion | Close the window at once instead of fading | Off |
| Show minimap button | Show the minimap button (left-click: preview, right-click: options; drag it around the minimap) | On |
| Reset position | Put the window back at its default spot | |
| Clear skill data | Forget the skills learned from trainers | |
| Test | Close the options and show a preview of the window | |
| Show last level-up | Bring back the window from your last level-up | |
| Show hidden skills | Bring back every skill you hid | |

## Commands

- `/lui` opens the settings.
- `/lui test` shows a preview of the window right now.
- `/lui last` brings back the window from your last level-up.

## Game versions

- WoW: Forever
- Classic Era
- TBC Anniversary

# Changelog

Player-friendly release notes for Level Up Info. This file covers the current 0.x series; older series live in [archive/changelog/](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/LevelUpInfo/blob/master/archive/changelog).

All releases: **0.1.x (current)**

## [Unreleased]

## [0.1.12] - 2026-11-21

- After a class trainer visit, a chat line tells you when Level Up Info now knows your class skills up to a higher level, and which level.

## [0.1.11] - 2026-11-22

- Fixed: rank change lines (like "Healing: 572-661 ▸ 685-796 (+113-135)") no longer get cut off with "…". They now use the full row width, and a line that still doesn't fit continues on the next line.

## [0.1.10] - 2026-11-16

- The level-up window now ends with a folded "Next at N" group listing the skills and prices the trainer teaches at your next level that has something new.
- New "Show last level-up" button in the options, and /lui last: brings back the window from your last level-up, with the same gains, even after a relog.
- Priests now see their new skills on their very first level-up, even before visiting a class trainer.
- The level-up window stays smaller: it shows four skills per group and stops growing at about 60% of the screen height, scrolling the rest.
- Hover a skill row to see a small crossed eye. Click it to hide that skill from the level-up window, all its ranks, for that character. Hidden skills wait in a folded "Hidden" group at the bottom with their total price, each with a faint eye always showing; click it to bring one back. "Show hidden skills" in the options brings them all back.

## [0.1.9] - 2026-11-12

- When every primary stat goes up by the same amount, the window shows one "All stats" line instead of five.
- Fixed: higher ranks of spells you can't learn yet (such as Binding Heal) no longer show up the first time the window opens.

## [0.1.8] - 2026-11-10

- Fixed: The level-up window no longer runs off the screen when it has many skills; it scrolls instead.

## [0.1.7] - 2026-11-09

- Fixed: higher ranks of a talent you haven't taken (like Mind Flay Rank 2 without the talent) no longer show up as skills to buy.

## [0.1.6] - 2026-11-08

- Fixed: after training a higher rank of a skill (like Rend Rank 2), its lower ranks no longer show up as not yet learned.

## [0.1.5] - 2026-11-07

- Each skill group shows what training all of it costs, in red when you can't afford it.

## [0.1.4] - 2026-11-06

- Press Escape to close the level-up window, like any other game window.

## [0.1.3] - 2026-11-05

- Click the Not yet learned or Weapon skills heading to fold that group. It stays folded on later level-ups, for all your characters, and shows how many entries it holds.
- The preview now shows every stat, so Strength, Agility, Intellect and Spirit appear alongside Stamina.
- Fixed: the preview no longer shows a Mana line for Warriors and Rogues during combat.

## [0.1.2] - 2026-11-04

- TBC Anniversary: Draenei are sent to the weapon master in The Exodar and Blood Elves to the one in Silvermoon City, for the weapons those masters teach.
- Classic Era and TBC Anniversary: priest racial spells and weapon skills now match your game version (TBC priests buy their racials from the class trainer, so no quest is suggested).
- `/lui test 70` works on TBC Anniversary.
- Fixed: Polearms now show at level 20 for 1 gold, when weapon masters teach them.

## [0.1.1] - 2026-10-24

- Talent points now show first in the level-up window, with a thin line separating them from your other stats.
- `/lui test` now includes the talent point you get from level 10 on, so the preview matches a real level-up.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-10-08

- First release: level-up window with stat gains and new class skills.
- Settings page under Options, AddOns, Level Up Info (also `/lui`): turn it off, change how long it stays, wait for combat to end, size, and reduced motion.
- `/lui test` shows a preview of the window.
- `/lui test 40` previews the window as if you had just reached level 40.
- The level-up window now also lists skills you skipped at earlier levels, priest racial spells from quests (with the quest and where to hand it in), and weapon skills with the weapon master, city and price.
- Weapon skills show their weapon's icon.
- Test button in the options page shows a preview of the window.
- Added a minimap button: left-click shows a preview of the window, right-click opens the options. Drag it around the minimap, or turn it off in the options.
- Dragging the minimap button slides it around the edge of the minimap, and open windows now cover it instead of it showing on top.
- Clearer colors: each stat has its own color and secondary text is gray.
- Cleaner layout: stat gains sit under their own Stats heading like the skill groups, rows have a little space between them, and each block stands apart by spacing instead of divider lines.
- Stat gains read like "Stamina 27 to 28 (+1)", with a small arrow between the values: the old value is gray and the gain is green.
- A window shown during combat fills in the old stat values as soon as combat ends.
- The level-up window now congratulates you on the level you reached.
- New ranks list what changed from the previous rank — damage, healing, cost, cast time — like patch notes, with the difference in green when it's better and red when it's worse, e.g. "Mana cost 25 to 40 (+15)" in red.
- Click `+N more` to scroll through the rest of the list in place, at the same size as before; `Show less` folds it back.
- Skills above your level show their rank too, so new ranks and what they change appear for them.
- Every skill list shows its first 5 skills, so a big level jump stays short; `+N more` shows the rest.
- New addon icon in the AddOns list.
- Works on Classic Era and TBC Anniversary: the window lists your trainer's skills after a visit.

- Settings page under Options, AddOns, Level Up Info (also `/lui`): turn it off, change how long it stays, wait for combat to end, size, and reduced motion.
- `/lui test` shows a preview of the window.
- `/lui test 40` previews the window as if you had just reached level 40.
- The level-up window now also lists skills you skipped at earlier levels, priest racial spells from quests (with the quest and where to hand it in), and weapon skills with the weapon master, city and price.
- Weapon skills show their weapon's icon.
- Test button in the options page shows a preview of the window.
- Added a minimap button: left-click shows a preview of the window, right-click opens the options. Drag it around the minimap, or turn it off in the options.
- Dragging the minimap button slides it around the edge of the minimap, and open windows now cover it instead of it showing on top.
- Clearer colors: each stat has its own color and secondary text is gray.
- Cleaner layout: stat gains sit under their own Stats heading like the skill groups, rows have a little space between them, and each block stands apart by spacing instead of divider lines.
- Stat gains read like "Stamina 27 to 28 (+1)", with a small arrow between the values: the old value is gray and the gain is green.
- A window shown during combat fills in the old stat values as soon as combat ends.
- The level-up window now congratulates you on the level you reached.
- New ranks list what changed from the previous rank — damage, healing, cost, cast time — like patch notes, with the difference in green when it's better and red when it's worse, e.g. "Mana cost 25 to 40 (+15)" in red.
- Click `+N more` to scroll through the rest of the list in place, at the same size as before; `Show less` folds it back.
- Skills above your level show their rank too, so new ranks and what they change appear for them.
- Every skill list shows its first 5 skills, so a big level jump stays short; `+N more` shows the rest.
- New addon icon in the AddOns list.
- Works on Classic Era and TBC Anniversary: the window lists your trainer's skills after a visit.
